outcome: Thyroid hormones/parameters (Free tri-iodothyronine, Thyroid peroxidase antibody)
finding: Bisphenols, particularly BPA, were associated with altered sex and thyroid hormone concentrations in newborn cord blood, including increased testosterone and free tri-iodothyronine, and decreased thyroid peroxidase antibody.
mod_finding: The relationship between bisphenols and sex and thyroid hormones was observed to vary by delivery mode.
